raw_text: Bangladesh is about to explode. Student groups are coordinating massive protests against the quota system on Telegram. I'm seeing mobilization messages across at least 15 university-specific groups. They're planning for internet shutdowns (pre-arranged offline meeting points). This is much bigger than the government realizes. Last time students organized like this in BD was 2018 road safety movement. The quota issue touches every family — 56% of government jobs reserved under various categories. Watch Dhaka on July 15-16.
